payload.body: You tend to show the part of yourself that other people expect, then surprise them with an opinion, choice, or reaction that is much less edited. Keeping that side private rarely feels natural for long. Somewhere along the way, being fully visible was linked with being judged, selfish, or difficult, so being seen can still bring relief and embarrassment at the same time. Let one honest choice stay visible instead of taking it back as soon as someone notices.
